copy_gaps: 'fallback': row 20's source word for the re-attached stop, not a keyed string (spec L402)
'62,729.8': row 20's re-attached stop, not a keyed string (spec L402)
row 20: no recompute line and no risk read-out are drawn for 62,729.8: the spec gives no figure, and sltp.readout's '= 1 R' (L286) belongs to the stop that defines R (no invented number; for E32-D05)

row 20: the read-out line keeps §4.1 L328's illustrative mark 64,012.5, though #4137 rule 3 attaches the fallback only once the market is through 63,900.0 (L402); the spec gives no figures for this state (for E32-D05)

'App-managed: moves the stop at +1 R only while CandleViewer runs; if it stops, the stop stays at 62,729.8, never lower.': §4.1 L343-344's breakeven sentence refilled with row 20's stop in force (62,729.8 for 63,900.0); the spec draws the sentence only at 63,900.0 (for E32-D05)
frozen: {hh:mm} is filled with 14:02, the time from E30-D02's drawn instance (E30:288; E17-D01:217 has the same time): E32-D02 quotes no time (§3.6 L236 and D4 L126 cite the key only)

{message}: row 22's SCR-063 banner line carries the account_notice's message verbatim (§3.6 L238; 23:4335 at e69a9200c, one role-neutral sentence per reason); neither the spec nor 23 quotes an instance, so the slot is drawn unfilled. 14:1406 (at e69a9200c) has SCR-063's older words ('Reconciling with the exchange…', 'Position data is being verified — actions temporarily limited'); not used

row 22 under oms.account_stale: D4 (L126) names no T2 for the owner's Loosen stop… although stale refuses order entry (23:4332 at e69a9200c) and §3.6 L238 sends only a tighten; drawn enabled as D4 reads (for E32-D05)
'→ 63,913.9 · 961 ticks below entry · risk 24.03 USDT (0.19 % of equity)': §3.4's recompute line for SCR-064 / lockout (the percent entry), not a keyed string (spec L190)

Every control is a composition from tokens, named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only, and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance or swap its glyph.
A focus ring is a 2 px inner stroke on a wrapper with space.inset.xs padding, so it sits 2 px off the control and adds 4 px on each side to the layout (CMP-039).

Segmented controls draw the anatomy's words verbatim, the selected one in capitals as written (BUY, LIMIT; §5.1 L458, §6.1 L628) and marked by the selected fill; the unit switch's '*' (L330) is that fill.
Frame captions, annotation labels, board titles, source lines and footers are board chrome, not product copy.
1 px outlines use cvlib's default stroke (1 px, inner) without binding border.hairline; 2 px boundaries and rings bind border.thick / border.focus (frames stay small: FRAME_NOTE).

Modal sizes are kit choices (the spec gives none): SCR-064 640 px wide, SCR-065 800 px (its minimum width 640 px collapses notional and cum. notional, §5.2 L519), SCR-069 720 px; heights hug the content except the 50-row frame (12 body rows, §5.2 L527).
No close (×) control is drawn in the dialog headers: §3.1 L152 names the verb, the object and the environment pill only; Esc closes (L151).

Every number is JetBrains Mono (§3.1 L155) in fields, cells, tiles and the read-out pairs; a number inside a sentence keeps the sentence's Inter, because a cvsheet v1 text node carries one typography.

Frames are named 'SCR-0xx / <state>' (§0 L47), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so no section can address a node inside a frame: every frame is rendered whole in one section (the kit keeps each under 24000 bytes; one over the 12000-byte budget is listed in live_checks).
